title: Gate3ClaimStateMachine
description: Formal state machine specification for Gate-3 claim lifecycle, enforcing single-winner CAS semantics, atomic lease expiry, and terminal claim immutability (Theorem C, FND-ARCH-007, Hard Blockers B & C).

states.name: UNCLAIMED
states.description: Initial state for an authorization before any runner has claimed an execution lease.

states.name: CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT
states.description: An active runner holds a time-bounded lease to execute and anchor the Gate-3 authorization.

states.name: COMMITTED
states.description: Terminal immutable state indicating successful atomic commit and final execution consumption. No further transitions permitted.

states.name: LEASE_EXPIRED_RECOVERABLE
states.description: The claiming runner failed or timed out before committing. The authorization is safely reclaimable by subsequent runs.

states.name: ABORTED_RELEASED
states.description: The claiming runner aborted or rolled back in-flight execution. The authorization is safely reclaimable by subsequent runs.

permitted_transitions.guard: Epoch generation and fencing token match; no existing COMMITTED or active CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT claim.
Atomic CAS: claiming_run_id matches, state is CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT, and lease_expires_at_utc > now_utc (rowcount == 1).
now_utc >= lease_expires_at_utc and state is CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT.
claiming_run_id matches and state is CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT.
Fresh runner claims authorization; lease has expired; epoch advances generation.
Fresh runner claims authorization; prior runner released claim; epoch advances generation.

forbidden_transitions.rationale: COMMITTED state is strictly immutable and cannot be rolled back or aborted.
COMMITTED state cannot expire or be recovered.
COMMITTED state cannot be reclaimed or overwritten.
Expired owner cannot commit without obtaining a fresh valid lease via claim_authorization_cas.
Aborted owner cannot commit without obtaining a fresh valid lease via claim_authorization_cas.
Authorizations cannot be directly committed without acquiring a lease in CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT.
